title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Maxell MX90 > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 02/2012
source: Source: SBD > ? > Lo-gen Cassette, kindly provided by Seaweed1010.

ai_review.summary: A pristine soundboard recording of an underrated, smoking second set – jazzy Scarlet>Fire, fierce Eyes of the World, and a shredding NFA make this 1982 show shine.
ai_review.review: The SBD source is praised as exceptionally clean with virtually no hiss, delivering crystal‑clear detail that lets the music breathe. Listeners rave about the second‑set energy, calling Scarlet>Fire “bouncy” and “jammy,” Eyes of the World short but fierce, and The Other One an insane three‑minute space jam, all wrapped in a relaxed, jazzy vibe reminiscent of ’77. Overall the performance is highlighted as possibly the best or most underrated 2nd set of the year.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and explicitly praise both the musical performance and the clean soundboard source, indicating an outstanding show with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a ‘killer clean SBD source’ with noticeably less hiss than other board recordings; crisp, balanced and very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the second set is reviewed, but it’s portrayed as a continuous, relaxed‑jazzy jam flow that builds from Scarlet>Fire into tight, high‑energy sequences.
